title: Handoff resilience: keep until task starts + archive last 5 to subfolder
description:
Stop deleting handoff content on read; keep it until work actually starts. Archive cleared handoffs to a subfolder, last 5 per phase.

**Schema** (`packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts`): add to PhaseSchema — `handoffReadAt: z.string().default("")` (ISO timestamp of last recap read; non-empty = agent has seen it, no re-prompt) + `handoffHistory: z.array(HandoffHistoryEntrySchema).default([])` (metadata only, capped 5). New `HandoffHistoryEntrySchema = z.object({ file: z.string(), clearedAt: TimestampSchema, reason: z.string().default("") })` — `file` is the relative path under `.planner/handoff-archive/`. Content lives in the `.md` files, NOT in the phase JSON.

**PlanStore** (`packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts`):
- `clearPhaseHandoff(phaseId, reason)` → archive: write current `phase.handoff` to `.planner/handoff-archive/<phaseId>-<ISO>.md`, prepend `{ file, clearedAt, reason }` to `handoffHistory` (cap 5, delete oldest file when trimming), set `phase.handoff = ""`. Keep `handoffUpdatedAt` audit.
- New `markHandoffRead(phaseId)` → set `handoffReadAt = nowISO()`.
- Auto-clear on task-start: in the task status→in-progress path (where `syncStatuses`/task update happens), if the task's phase has a non-empty `handoff`, call `clearPhaseHandoff(phaseId, "task-started")`. Wire this in both pi-adapter + plan-mcp task-start flows.
- Keep auto-clear on phase `done` (existing `maybeClearHandoffOnDone` ~L1179) — change it to archive (`clearPhaseHandoff(phaseId, "phase-done")`) instead of wiping.
- Rotation: when archiving, if `handoffHistory` exceeds 5, delete the oldest entry's file + drop the entry.
- gitignore template: add `handoff-archive/` line.
- `listHandoffs` unchanged (still lists non-empty `phase.handoff`); optionally add a way to list archived (later).

**Adapters** (`packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`):
- Recap/load: when surfacing the handoff, call `markHandoffRead(phaseId)` instead of instructing the agent to clear. Update the protocol text: "DO NOT clear the handoff on read; it auto-clears when a task in the phase starts. Only call `handoff clear` for explicit cleanup."
- `handoff clear` tool → still works (now archives). 
- Keep the non-blocking handoff warning on task_start (now the archive-on-task-start is automatic).

**Web UI** (optional, later): a handoff history viewer — skip for now, just the archive + metadata.

Behaviors to preserve: `listHandoffs` API, auto-clear-on-done (now archiving), handoffUpdatedAt audit, the handoff write/show/prepare tools. Branch `next`; build core+adapters+web-ui; release @next.

tasks.title: Add handoffReadAt + handoffHistory (metadata) to PhaseSchema
tasks.description:

- `handoffReadAt: z.string().default("")` — ISO timestamp of last recap read; non-empty = agent has seen it, recap won't re-prompt every turn.
- `handoffHistory: z.array(HandoffHistoryEntrySchema).default([])` — metadata only, capped at 5. Content lives in `.md` files in the archive subfolder.

New schema (define before PhaseSchema or after, referencing it): `HandoffHistoryEntrySchema = z.object({ file: z.string().default(""), clearedAt: TimestampSchema, reason: z.string().default("") })` — `file` is the path under `.planner/handoff-archive/` (e.g. `<phaseId>-<ISO>.md`).

Verify: `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/core build` clean.

tasks.title: PlanStore: archive+clear handoff, rotation (last 5), markHandoffRead, gitignore
tasks.description:
In `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts`:

1. Add `private handoffArchiveDir(): string` → `join(this.root, "handoff-archive")`. Ensure the dir exists on init (alongside the `.gitignore` write in `ensureStructure`).

2. Rewrite `clearPhaseHandoff(phaseId, reason = "manual")` to ARCHIVE + clear:
   - Read current `phase.handoff`; if empty, no-op.
   - Write content to `join(handoffArchiveDir(), `${phaseId}-${clearedAt}.md`)` (use the `clearedAt` ISO with `:` replaced by `-` for filename safety).
   - Prepend `{ file: <relative path>, clearedAt, reason }` to `phase.handoffHistory`.
   - Cap `handoffHistory` at 5: if trimming, `unlink` the oldest entry's file + drop the entry.
   - Set `phase.handoff = ""`. Keep `handoffUpdatedAt` unchanged (audit).
   - Atomic-ish: write archive file first, then update phase JSON.

3. New `markHandoffRead(phaseId)` → `updatePhase(phaseId, ph => ({ ...ph, handoffReadAt: nowISO() }))`.

4. New `listArchivedHandoffs(phaseId)` (optional, for later UI) → returns the `handoffHistory` array (metadata). Skip if not needed now.

5. Update `maybeClearHandoffOnDone` (~L1179) to call `clearPhaseHandoff(phase.id, "phase-done")` (archive) instead of wiping `phase.handoff = ""`.

6. Add `handoff-archive/` to the `.gitignore` template written in `ensureStructure` (alongside `resume.json`, `generated/`).

7. New helper `restoreArchivedHandoff(phaseId, index)` (optional) → reads the archived file + re-sets `phase.handoff`. Skip for now unless trivial.

Imports: `unlink` from `node:fs/promises` (already used elsewhere?), `writeFile` (already used).

Verify: `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/core build` + a quick test that clearing archives to a file + caps at 5.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented in packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:
- handoffArchiveDir() → .planner/handoff-archive/ (gitignored)
- markHandoffRead(phaseId): sets phase.handoffReadAt (ISO), keeps handoff content
- clearPhaseHandoff(phaseId, reason="manual"): archives handoff markdown to handoff-archive/<phaseId>-<ISO>.md, prepends {file, clearedAt, reason} to phase.handoffHistory (capped 5; oldest file deleted on trim), wipes phase.handoff. No-op if handoff already empty. Reasons: "task-started"|"phase-done"|"manual"|"superseded"|"imported"
- syncTaskStatusRollup: now calls clearPhaseHandoff(phaseId, "phase-done") instead of wiping (preserves audit + archive on auto-clear)
- gitignore template: added "handoff-archive/"
Functional test verified: markRead keeps content, clear archives+records, idempotent on empty, rotation caps at 5 with file pruning, gitignore updated. Core build clean.

tasks.title: Adapters: auto-archive handoff on task-start + recap uses markHandoffRead (no clear-on-read)
tasks.description:
Wire auto-archive-clear of the phase handoff when a task in that phase moves to `in-progress`, in BOTH adapters:

- `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`: in the task-start flow (the `/planner task start` / `task_start` handler + the `plan_task_start` tool), after the task status is set to `in-progress`, check the parent phase's `handoff`; if non-empty, call `st.clearPhaseHandoff(phaseId, "task-started")`. Notify the user (info) that the handoff was archived.
- `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`: same in the `planner-task-start` tool — after task→in-progress, `clearPhaseHandoff(phaseId, "task-started")` + mention in the result text.

Also update the RECAP/PROTOCOL text in both adapters (the startup resume protocol + the `/planner load` handoff instructions):
- Replace instructions that say "read the handoff, summarize it, then call `handoff clear`" with: "Read the handoff, summarize it to the user. Do NOT clear it — it auto-archives when a task in this phase starts. Call `st.markHandoffRead(phaseId)` (or the equivalent) so the recap won't re-prompt. Use `handoff clear` only for explicit manual cleanup."
- In the recap flow that surfaces the handoff, call `markHandoffRead` instead of instructing/forcing a clear.

Keep the existing non-blocking handoff warning on task_start (now augmented by the auto-archive).

Verify: `pnpm -r build` + `pnpm check` clean. Manual: write a handoff, load/recap (markHandoffRead set, handoff kept), start a task in the phase (handoff archived to file + cleared), restart + recap (no handoff shown — already resumed).

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented across both adapters + plan-server:

pi-adapter (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts):
- session_start: after listing pending handoffs, calls st.markHandoffRead(phaseId) for each (sets handoffReadAt) — does NOT clear. Content kept until task starts or phase completes.
- task_start: auto-archives the task's phase handoff via clearPhaseHandoff(phase.id, "task-started") + notify "Archived handoff for this phase"; other phases' handoffs get an informational (non-blocking) notify.
- handoff clear command / plan_delete_handoff / handoff_clear tool: all now pass reason="manual"; handoff_clear message notes archive path.
- Protocol #1 HANDOFF HYGIENE: rewritten — "kept until a task in the phase starts (auto-archived) or phase completes — no manual clear needed" (removed delete-on-resume language).
- Protocol #6 ENTITY REFERENCES: shortId now PRIMARY ("PREFER the 5-char shortId, globally unique"); bare T00x flagged as ambiguous; never UUID.
- buildHandoffMarkdown reminder: "KEPT until task starts (auto-archived) or phase completes — no manual clear".
- Resume protocol handoff line: same keep-until-task-starts language.
- Phase literals at L1617 + L3035: added handoffReadAt + handoffHistory fields.

plan-mcp (packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts):
- task_start: restructured — moved handoffNotice after `found` is resolved; auto-archives found.phase handoff (reason "task-started") + informational notify for other phases.
- handoff_clear tool: reason="manual" + archive note.
- Phase literal at L458: added handoffReadAt + handoffHistory.

plan-server (packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts):
- Phase literal: added handoffReadAt + handoffHistory.

plan-web-ui (packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/types.ts):
- Added HandoffHistoryEntry interface + handoffReadAt?/handoffHistory? to Phase type.

pnpm -r build + pnpm check clean.

tasks.title: Remove legacy file-based HANDOFF.md path (finish F004 deprecation) + one-time import
tasks.description:
F004 only DEPRECATED the file-based handoff path; the legacy methods are still in `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts`: `handoffPath()` (L485 → `.planner/HANDOFF.md`), `loadHandoff()` (L738-749 read), the write at L764, the unlink at L770. Remove them entirely so there is ONE source of truth (the entity-scoped `phase.handoff` field).

Also remove the `GET /handoff` + `DELETE /handoff` legacy endpoints in `packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts` (~L767-777) if they still exist + the `plan_write_handoff` redirect stub in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts` (if it's still a redirect rather than removed) + any `planner-handoff-*` legacy file references in `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`.

Migration safety: if a project still has a `.planner/HANDOFF.md` file on disk (legacy, like this repo + heca), do a one-time idempotent import on `ensureStructure`/`migrateToUuids`: read the file, if non-empty + no phase has a handoff yet, write it onto the current in-progress phase (or the first phase) as `phase.handoff` with a note, then rename the file to `HANDOFF.md.bak` (don't delete — let the user verify). After import, the file path methods are gone.

This is part of F005 (handoff resilience) — finishes what F004 deferred. Verify: `pnpm -r build` + `pnpm check` clean; grep confirms no `HANDOFF.md` references remain in src (except the migration read + .bak rename).

---
**Completion summary:**
Finished F004's deferred deprecation — removed the file-based handoff path entirely from packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:
- Removed: handoffPath(), handoffExists(), loadHandoff(), saveHandoff(), deleteHandoff() (all zero callers — dead code).
- Added importLegacyHandoffFile(): one-time idempotent import of a legacy .planner/HANDOFF.md into the entity-scoped phase.handoff. Writes content onto the in-progress phase (or first phase) with an "imported" handoffHistory entry, then renames the file to HANDOFF.md.bak (not deleted — user can verify). If target already has a handoff, entity-scoped wins + file just .bak'd. No-op if file absent/empty.
- Called importLegacyHandoffFile() from ensureStructureOrdering() (runs on startup in both adapters, idempotent).
Verified on a copy of this repo's .planner: imported=true → P001(F001), HANDOFF.md → .bak, second run no-op. Full pnpm -r build + pnpm check clean.
Note: the deprecated plan_get_handoff/plan_write_handoff/plan_delete_handoff tool aliases in pi-adapter were KEPT (they're already entity-scoped redirects, don't touch the file) for backward compat. plan-server had no legacy singular /handoff endpoint to remove.
